caption:
You bought a CRM before.

It's probably still open in a browser tab somewhere, half set up, untouched since month two. That's not a reason to avoid trying again. It's a reason to look at why rollouts fail.

Industry research keeps landing on the same root cause: poor adoption, not bad software.

The fix isn't more features. Start with one manual task you repeat every week and let the system handle that one thing first. No team meeting. No migration weekend.

Test it against your own leads before you decide anything.

DM TRIAL

rationale: Carousels still win saves/depth for B2B objection content, and the shelfware/past-bad-experience fear is a genuinely unclaimed objection distinct from every prior cost, impersonal, lock-in, complexity, spam, adoption, migration, and accuracy objection already shipped.
